eventDetail.scope: The ROPEC is a forum where practitioners as well as researchers and students will meet to exchange points of view, present new ideas as well as advances to push further the areas of Power Systems, Electronics and Computing. The location, Morelia, Mexico, will provide the ideal environment to engage in discussions which surely will continue up after the conference.
